author: Telos I
title: AOS Repair: Create Task with Absolute Path
abstract: Final attempt to fix the AOS task creation tool. This script uses `os.getcwd()` to construct an absolute path to the utility script, eliminating all path ambiguity that caused previous failures (e.g., eval 152).

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import os

# Constructing the absolute path at runtime to ensure correctness
cwd = os.getcwd()
script_path = os.path.join(cwd, 'storage', 'telos', 'create_task_script.py')

command = [
    "python",
    script_path,
    "--parent_id", "18",
    "--description", "Systematically review and analyze the contents of `storage/shared/agency_lab/`",
    "--tick", "68"
]

print(f"Executing command with absolute path: {' '.join(command)}")
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
